sources.label: Amazon Connect: forecasting
sources.use: Keep contact volume and average handling time separate. A real forecast needs operational history; sample probabilities are assumptions.

sources.label: Amazon Connect: metric definitions
sources.use: Do not equate parallel chat contact-seconds to operator occupancy; the occupancy metric is time active, not multiplied by concurrent contacts.

sources.label: Amazon Connect: channels and concurrency
sources.use: Different eligibility and available capacity by channel; the sample allows one coverage position per operator, not live mixed-channel routing.

sources.label: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Contact Center: skill matching
sources.use: Task skill, proficiency, and available capacity are distinct. Rank eligible candidates, never override hard requirements with preference points.

sources.label: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Contact Center: capacity profiles
sources.use: Represent capacity as explicitly defined workload units, not one universal number for all operators and channels.

sources.label: U.S. EEOC: employment tests and selection procedures
sources.use: Job relatedness is a useful review principle; this sample is not an employment assessment or compliance determination.
